This was an application of the Force performed by [[Jaden Korr]] in [[41 ABY|41.5 ABY]]. After taking the defeated [[Kam Solusar]] clone [[Alpha (clone)|Alpha's]] [[Jaden Korr's third lightsaber|unstable red]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Jaden decided to make it his own. Reluctant to use a [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|red crystal]], and not wanting an inadequate blade, Korr removed the crystal and '''cleansed''' it of all impurities, fixing the blade and changing the color from [[Color/Legends|red]] to yellow. Jaden was especially pleased with the color change, due to the fact that a yellow blade was traditionally associated with [[Jedi Sentinel/Legends|Jedi Sentinels]], who balanced [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] with [[Lightsaber combat/Legends|lightsaber combat]]; something that fit Jaden's style just perfectly. When showing his success to [[Marr Idi-Shael]] and [[Khedryn Faal]], they were completely amazed, Faal even asking him why Jaden couldn't purge the [[Cloning/Legends|Community]] clones of imperfections, just like he did with the crystal.  Korr explained that people were far to complex to change with this power.<ref>[[Riptide (novel)|''Riptide'']]</ref>
